AAT_keyword_ZN: 湖;中国;日本;船;分布;大;北;帆;琵琶;帆;文字;舱内;波;帆;海
藏品名称_EN: Eight-sided eight-pronged mirror of Shuangpo Changtianhai ware
描述_EN: A sailing ship sails across the ocean, with dragons and fish peeking out from the waves. In addition to the octagonal mirrors, there are also round mirrors of several types, depending on the design and the presence or absence of the words "Huang Pi Chang Tian". They are found in the northern half of China, Korea and a wide area of Japan, and there are many examples of these mirrors in the Korean Peninsula. In Japan, it is enshrined in shrines of seafaring gods, such as Oyoshijima Shrine on Tsushima Island and Isozaki Shrine on Lake Biwa, probably due to the content of the design.
描述_ZN: 一艘帆船驶过海洋，龙和鱼从波浪中探出头来。 除了八角形的镜子外，还有圆形的镜子，根据设计和有无 "煌丕昌天 "字样，有几种类型。 它们分布在中国北半部、韩国和日本的广大地区，在朝鲜半岛有许多这种镜子的例子。 在日本，它被供奉在航海神的神社里，如对马岛的大吉岛神社和琵琶湖畔的矶崎神社，这可能是由于设计的内容所决定的。
